digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and normalization
propositions: The criteria labels 'sec' and 'documentation' are model-emitted synonyms of packaged criteria 'security' and 'docs' but lack normalization, causing them to miss tuned thresholds and fall to the default 0.95 posture

A synonym mapping (not a whitelist) must normalize 'sec' to 'security' and 'documentation' to 'docs' before threshold lookup in code_review_decide, while preserving open dimensions and project-supplied criteria unchanged

The calibration document embeds five load-bearing errors: misstating 'sec' and 'documentation' as non-tunable, computing 'security' on a truncated sample, misreporting 'project.review-phase-boundaries' as low-data, mischaracterizing and under-listing data-hygiene labels, and failing to disclose that the calibration script reads no routing index

All corrections to the calibration document must explicitly state that comparisons were made against the packaged index rather than effective vocabulary, that dimension labels are open by design, and that the four approved blocking flips and block-impact table remain unaffected
After normalization, a docs-criteria finding with impact > 0 must surface and one with impact 0 must be dropped to preserve impact-aware nit-suppression behavior
